subject: Follow-up: align economic buyer & 1M-token pricing for Acme Health PoC
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Redwood + Acme Health — pricing & action items

Hi Elena — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can lock timelines: 

What we heard (high level):
- Pilot scope: inference for triage classifier + summarization in production-like traffic (expected initial steady state 1–2M tokens/mo, ability to spike to ~5M).
- Primary success metric: production-latency under 250ms median and F1 lift >= 6 pts on our validation set.
- Target unit economics you mentioned: wanting sub-$50 / 1M tokens as a long-term target.

Redwood follow-ups / asks: 
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and the finance approver who will sign budget? (We heard Martin may be the exec sponsor, but need a finance contact.)
2) Confirm the budget range you have in mind for the initial 90-day pilot and what threshold would trigger a dedicated capacity conversation.
3) Please review the attached draft mutual action plan (MAP) — I’ve called out milestones and expected token ramps.

Proposed next steps:
- If you confirm Martin + finance approver, we’ll schedule a 30-min alignment call next week with pricing and procurement to fast-track the PoC paperwork.
- We can offer a short pilot credit (up to 3M tokens) conditioned on the success metrics above — we’ll outline the terms on the MAP.

Attachment: redwood-map-acme-v1.pdf (draft MAP)

Thanks — cc’ing Jordan and Priya to keep procurement and pricing looped in.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com | (415) 555-0191

From: Elena Morales <elena@acmehealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Cc: Martin Vega <martin.vega@acmehealth.com>, Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@acmehealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood + Acme Health — pricing & action items

Ava — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Back to the details you asked about: 

- Economic buyer / sponsor: Martin Vega, VP Product (martin.vega@acmehealth.com) — he’s committed to the product outcomes but will need finance sign-off for any multi-month committed spend.
- Finance approver / budget owner: Sofia Ruiz (sofia.ruiz@acmehealth.com) — she manages 3rd-party SaaS approvals.
- Budget range: for the initial PoC and Q3 ramp we have a target committed budget in the $40k–$75k/month range depending on final unit price and SLO guarantees.
- Token profile: expect 2M tokens/mo steady in pilot with a projected ramp to ~10M/mo over 9–12 months if pilot meets KPIs.

Our procurement team also needs a short SOC2 & data-flow summary. Attaching the SOC2 exclusions doc they wanted us to share (see attachment).

Attachment: acme-soc2-exclusions.pdf

If you can draft a 30-min slot next week with Martin + Sofia + your pricing lead, that would be ideal.

Elena
Senior PM, Clinical Products | Acme Health
elena@acmehealth.com | +1 212-555-0144

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood + Acme Health — pricing & action items

Looping in internal next steps on pricing. Ava / Priya — a few internal notes: 

- Deal ID: RDW-2026-2391. Given the 2–10M token profile, we should prepare a tiered band: pilot (0–3M tokens) at pilot credit, then a committed band pricing that gets to ~$35–$45 / 1M tokens at higher volumes.
- I attached a quick calc of monthly example econs based on Elena’s ranges — use it for the pricing call.
- Priya — can you own finance outreach and start the initial PO/contract checklist? Sofia will need GL codes, invoicing cadence, and our standard SOC2 attestations.

Attachment: pricing-calc-ava-20260718.xlsx

If we want to accelerate the Dedicated conversation, we should get Martin in a short call this week to confirm target SLA/throughput. Ava — can you propose 2x 30-min windows?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@acmehealth.com>, Martin Vega <martin.vega@acmehealth.com>, Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood + Acme Health — pricing & action items

Thanks Elena — great clarity. Quick confirmation and next steps from our side: 

1) We can commit to a 3-week pilot with up to 3M tokens on Redwood-hosted infra at no charge (pilot credit) provided the success metrics are met (latency <250ms median and F1 lift >= 6 pts). If successful, we’ll convert to a paid agreement with a ramping committed band.
2) Proposed target unit price for planning: $45 / 1M tokens for the initial committed band (negotiable based on committed volume and SLA).
3) Proposed meeting: Tue 2026-07-21 10:00am PT or Wed 2026-07-22 11:00am PT — 30 minutes to align Martin + Sofia + pricing and procurement. Please confirm which slot works.

Priya — can you capture procurement checklist items and send Sofia a single-sheet with invoicing options and required docs? Jordan — will join the call for pricing details.

Elena / Martin / Sofia — please reply with the preferred meeting time and confirm that Martin is the economic approver and Sofia will own finance sign-off. Once I have confirmation I’ll send a calendar invite and update the MAP (attached earlier).

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com | (415) 555-0191
